context.body: Paul stood up, and gesturing with his hand said, “Men of Israel, and you who fear God, listen.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Paul recounts Israel from Egypt through judges and Saul, says God raised David and testified about his heart and will, then announces Jesus from David’s offspring.
observations.label: Paul moves from David’s selection to a Savior from his offspring: textual observation

observations.body: The passage keeps Paul, Israel, God, Saul, David, Samuel, Jesus, and hearers, the synagogue and Israel’s narrated history, recounting, removing Saul, raising David, testifying, promising offspring, and bringing a Savior visible within David's story or later memory.
observations.label: Paul moves from David’s selection to a Savior from his offspring: action, promise, or consequence

observations.body: Paul, Israel, God, Saul, David, Samuel, Jesus, and hearers · the synagogue and Israel’s narrated history · recounting, removing Saul, raising David, testifying, promising offspring, and bringing a Savior · David’s character testimony and descendant promise form a hinge toward Jesus
observations.label: Relationships named in Acts 13:16–23

payload.posture: Read Acts 13:16–23 as its own gospel and apostolic memory David setting before carrying its language into another source.
payload.tension: The source places David’s character testimony and descendant promise form a hinge toward Jesus inside this David setting without explaining every motive, transition, or later consequence.
